operations.name: weft.activities.complete
operations.summary: Complete a deferred activity by task token
operations.description: Resolve an out-of-band ("async") activity with a result, resuming its parked workflow as though the activity had returned that result inline. Requires the durable task token announced through the `activity:async-pending` event. Faults with NotFound when the token is unknown or already completed/failed (tokens are single-use), and InvalidParams when the result exceeds the payload size limit. A success response is durable — the completion is persisted before the operation returns, and a crash afterward cannot lose it. A failed call leaves the token completable, so treat storage-side faults as retryable.

operations.name: weft.activities.fail
operations.summary: Fail a deferred activity by task token
operations.description: Fail an out-of-band ("async") activity, throwing the supplied error into its parked workflow at the deferred step — identical to an inline activity that threw, so the workflow’s own try/catch and retry policy apply unchanged. Requires the durable task token from the `activity:async-pending` event. Faults with NotFound when the token is unknown or already completed/failed (tokens are single-use), and InvalidParams when the failure message exceeds the payload size limit. A success response is durable — the failure outcome is persisted before the operation returns, and a crash afterward cannot lose it. A failed call leaves the token completable, so treat storage-side faults as retryable.

operations.name: weft.alerts.list
operations.summary: List currently firing alerts
operations.description: List the alert rules that are currently firing, including their metric, threshold, current value, configured window, and firing timestamp. Read-only and limited to active in-memory alert state; resolved alerts are not returned.

operations.name: weft.events.sse
operations.summary: Stream fleet events as Server-Sent Events
operations.description: Streams the server-level event feed across workflows. Optional filters narrow delivery by workflow id or event kind after the single fleet cursor has been applied. The stream emits `ping` keepalives while idle.

operations.name: weft.events.subscribe
operations.summary: Subscribe to fleet-wide events with replay-from-cursor
operations.description: Subscribes to the server-level event feed across workflows. Optional filters narrow delivery by workflow id or event kind after the single fleet cursor has been applied. Historical replay is capped at 1,000 matching retained events per subscription; use a recent fromCursor for older feeds.

operations.name: weft.recover.all
operations.summary: Recover all interrupted workflows

operations.name: weft.retention.get
operations.summary: Get retention policy overview

operations.name: weft.reviews.decision.submit
operations.summary: Submit a decision for a human review
operations.description: Submit an approve/reject (or option) decision for a pending human review, resuming the waiting workflow down the corresponding branch. The decision is final and cannot be retracted — the same finality as a signal. Faults with NotFound when the review is not visible.

operations.name: weft.reviews.get
operations.summary: Get a specific review for a workflow
operations.description: Read a single human review request for a workflow by its identifiers, including the review prompt, available options, and current decision state. Read-only. Faults with NotFound when the review is not visible.

operations.name: weft.reviews.list
operations.summary: List human review requests
operations.description: List pending human-in-the-loop review requests, optionally filtered by workflow. Read-only. Returns each review request with its prompt, options, and originating workflow so an operator or agent can decide on it via the review-decision operation.

operations.name: weft.schedules.cancel
operations.summary: Cancel a recurring schedule
operations.description: Permanently cancel a recurring schedule by `scheduleId` so it stops launching new workflows. Irreversible — recreate the schedule to resume the cadence. Already-started workflows are unaffected. Faults with NotFound when no schedule with the given id exists.

operations.name: weft.schedules.create
operations.summary: Create a recurring schedule
operations.description: Create a schedule that starts a workflow on a recurring cadence. Requires a schedule `id`, the target workflow `type`, and a recurrence specification (cron expression or interval); accepts the workflow `input` and start options. Returns the created schedule id. Faults with Conflict when a schedule with the same id already exists and InvalidParams for a malformed recurrence specification.

cronExpression.description: Cron expression. Supply exactly one of cronExpression or every; runtime validation requires a non-empty string.

description.description: Operator-facing schedule description. Runtime validation requires a string.

every.description: Interval period (duration string or milliseconds). Supply exactly one of cronExpression or every.

type.description: Workflow type name. Runtime validation requires a non-empty string.

operations.name: weft.schedules.get
operations.summary: Get a recurring schedule by id
operations.description: Read a single recurring schedule by `id`, including its recurrence specification, target workflow type, paused state, and next-run information. Read-only. Faults with NotFound when no schedule with the given id exists.

operations.name: weft.schedules.list
operations.summary: List recurring schedules
operations.description: List recurring schedules with pagination. Read-only. Returns each schedule with its recurrence specification, target workflow type, and paused state.

operations.name: weft.schedules.pause
operations.summary: Pause a recurring schedule
operations.description: Pause a recurring schedule by `scheduleId` so it stops launching new workflows while retaining its definition. Reversible via resume. Faults with NotFound when no schedule with the given id exists.

operations.name: weft.schedules.resume
operations.summary: Resume a recurring schedule
operations.description: Resume a paused recurring schedule by `scheduleId` so it begins launching workflows on its cadence again. Faults with NotFound when no schedule with the given id exists.

operations.name: weft.schedules.update
operations.summary: Update a recurring schedule
operations.description: Update an existing recurring schedule by `id`, replacing its recurrence specification and optionally changing description, overlap, backfill, or jitter. Omitted options retain their persisted values; schedule id, workflow type, and input remain unchanged. Returns null on success. Faults with NotFound when no schedule with the given id exists and InvalidParams for malformed fields.

cronExpression.description: Cron expression. Supply exactly one of cronExpression or every; runtime validation requires a non-empty string.

description.description: Operator-facing schedule description. Runtime validation requires a string.

every.description: Interval period (duration string or milliseconds). Supply exactly one of cronExpression or every.

operations.name: weft.system.metrics
operations.summary: Get JSON-shaped system metrics

operations.name: weft.system.principal
operations.summary: Report the caller's resolved principal and granted scopes
operations.description: Report the caller's own resolved principal: the authentication method ('jwt', 'api-key', 'mtls', 'stdio-local', or 'unauthenticated'), the normalized subject when one exists, and the granted authorization scopes, sorted. Public access: an unauthenticated caller receives method 'unauthenticated' with an empty scope list rather than an error, so clients can distinguish "no credential" from "credential with few scopes" without probing other operations. Reflects only the request credential — never server auth configuration.

operations.name: weft.system.registry
operations.summary: Get a snapshot of registered workflows and activities with their JSON Schemas

operations.name: weft.task.queues.list
operations.summary: List task queues with backlog, waiting pollers, and per-queue saturation

operations.name: weft.tasks.diagnostics
operations.summary: Get bounded task latency and stuck-work diagnostics

operations.name: weft.tasks.diagnostics.deadletters.clear
operations.summary: Clear a task-result dead-letter diagnostic entry

operations.name: weft.tasks.get
operations.summary: Get one task's full durable ledger state

operations.name: weft.updates.result.get
operations.summary: Get the result of an update request

operations.summary: Mark a worker deployment as draining

operations.name: weft.worker.deployments.resume
operations.summary: Clear a worker deployment drain marker

operations.name: weft.workers.diagnostics
operations.summary: Get bounded instance and deployment-version diagnostics for one connected worker
operations.description: Report one connected worker's identity split into two parts: `instance` (this live connection — queue, health, connection timestamps) and `deploymentVersion` (the artifact it loaded — SDK/runtime identity, manifest digest, and every advertised workflow's version, revision, and contract hash). Returns `worker: null` when the workerId is not currently connected. Excludes capabilities and raw payload schemas.

operations.name: weft.workers.drain
operations.summary: Mark a connected worker as draining
operations.description: Mark a connected worker as draining by `workerId` so the engine stops dispatching new tasks to it while in-flight tasks finish, with an optional `reason`. Used for graceful shutdown and rolling deploys; clear the marker with the worker-resume operation. Faults with NotFound when no worker with the given id is connected.

operations.name: weft.workers.list
operations.summary: List connected workers, their advertised activities, and saturation
operations.description: List workers currently connected to the engine, including each worker id, its advertised activities and workflows, drain state, and saturation. Read-only. Use this to observe the worker fleet before draining or rebalancing.

operations.name: weft.workers.rejections
operations.summary: List recently declined worker registration attempts
operations.description: Bounded, most-recent-first log of declined `register` attempts: rejection code, attempted workerId when known, and whatever deployment/queue identity had already been parsed by the time the rejecting gate ran. No free-text message and no manifest content.

operations.name: weft.workers.resume
operations.summary: Clear a connected worker drain marker

operations.name: weft.workflows.activities.pending.list
operations.summary: List pending async activities for a workflow
operations.description: Read a bounded, deterministic page of durable activity task tokens awaiting out-of-band completion. The cursor is opaque and scoped to the selected workflow. A listed token may be consumed concurrently, so a later completion can return NotFound.

operations.summary: Add or remove workflow tags in bulk

operations.name: weft.workflows.cancel
operations.summary: Cancel a running workflow
operations.description: Request cancellation of a running workflow by `id`. Cancellation is cooperative: the workflow observes a cancellation signal and unwinds via its own cleanup logic, so this is irreversible from the caller perspective. Faults with NotFound when the workflow is not visible.

operations.name: weft.workflows.checkpoints.get
operations.summary: Get a specific checkpoint by step number

operations.name: weft.workflows.checkpoints.list
operations.summary: List checkpoint history for a workflow

operations.name: weft.workflows.events
operations.summary: Subscribe to workflow events with replay-from-cursor
operations.description: `selector: "events"` requires `events:read`; `selector: "tokens"` requires `streams:read`. The grant is checked when the WebSocket subscription starts and remains active until unsubscribe, socket close, or feed termination.

operations.name: weft.workflows.events.list
operations.summary: Get workflow events by id

operations.name: weft.workflows.events.sse
operations.summary: Stream workflow events as Server-Sent Events
operations.description: `selector: "events"` requires `events:read`; `selector: "tokens"` requires `streams:read`. The stream replays from `fromCursor` or `Last-Event-ID`, then remains open for live events and `ping` keepalives.

operations.name: weft.workflows.finalizer.get
operations.summary: Get workflow finalizer progress and outcome
operations.description: Read durable post-terminal finalizer progress or its succeeded or failed outcome. Returns null when the workflow did not record finalizer work.

operations.name: weft.workflows.fork
operations.summary: Fork a workflow from a checkpoint

operations.name: weft.workflows.get
operations.summary: Get workflow state by id
operations.description: Read the current state of a single workflow by `id`, including its status, timestamps, tags, and search attributes. Read-only. Faults with NotFound when no workflow with the given id is visible.

operations.name: weft.workflows.list
operations.summary: List workflows
operations.description: List workflows visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status, type, originating schedule, direct parent run, tags, id prefix, failure category, and time range, with pagination via `limit`/`offset`. Read-only. Returns the matching workflow summaries in the engine default ordering.

operations.name: weft.workflows.purge
operations.summary: Purge terminal workflows

operations.name: weft.workflows.query
operations.summary: Query workflow state by id
operations.description: Run a named read-only query handler against a workflow and return its result. Requires the workflow `id` and the query `name`; `input` is optional. Queries do not mutate workflow state. Faults with NotFound when the workflow is not visible.

operations.name: weft.workflows.replay
operations.summary: Replay a workflow to a historical checkpoint step
operations.description: Reconstruct the historical state of a workflow at a given checkpoint step and return a replay view. This is a read-only reconstruction via the engine replay machinery — the live workflow is never mutated or rewound. Faults with NotFound when the workflow or checkpoint step is not visible.

operations.name: weft.workflows.result.get
operations.summary: Get workflow result by id

operations.name: weft.workflows.resume
operations.summary: Resume a suspended or recovered workflow
operations.description: Re-drive a workflow from its persisted checkpoint by `workflowId`, returning the workflow `id`. Accepts a workflow that was explicitly suspended (`weft.workflows.suspend`) or one left running by a prior process; a suspended workflow is durably flipped back to running as part of resuming. Faults with NotFound when the workflow is not visible, or Conflict when it is in a status that cannot be resumed (terminal or pending).

operations.name: weft.workflows.scheduleprovenance.get
operations.summary: Get the schedule occurrence that launched a workflow
operations.description: Read the durable schedule id and optional occurrence timestamp that launched a workflow. Returns null for runs that were not launched by a schedule or whose workflow history was purged.

operations.name: weft.workflows.signal
operations.summary: Send a signal to a workflow
operations.description: Deliver a named signal with an optional payload to a running workflow. Requires the workflow `id` and the signal `name`; `payload` is optional. Signals are fire-and-forget from the caller perspective and do not return a handler result. Faults with NotFound when the workflow is not visible and InvalidParams when the payload exceeds the size limit.

operations.name: weft.workflows.start
operations.summary: Start a new workflow
operations.description: Start a new workflow execution of a registered type. Requires `type` (the registered workflow type name) and accepts an optional `input` payload plus start options: `id` (client-supplied workflow id), `executionTimeout`, `startAt`/`startAfter` (mutually exclusive scheduling), `tags`, `idempotencyKey` (at-most-once dedup: a repeated key returns the existing run instead of starting a second), and `searchAttributes`. Returns the workflow `id`. Faults with InvalidParams for an unregistered type or malformed options, and Conflict when a workflow with the same id already exists or the supplied `idempotencyKey` has been spent (its run was purged or swept by retention).

type.description: Workflow type name. Runtime validation requires a non-empty string.

operations.name: weft.workflows.startorsignal
operations.summary: Atomically start a workflow or signal it if it already exists
operations.description: Start a workflow or deliver a signal to it if it already exists (signal-with-start). An absent target is created and delivered the signal in one batch; a non-terminal target (running, pending, or suspended) is signalled; a terminal target faults with Conflict unless `onTerminalConflict: "start-new"` is supplied with `id` and `signalId`, in which case the prior terminal run is replaced through the shared terminal-replacement path and the initial signal is delivered to the fresh run. A spent `idempotencyKey` whose run was purged or swept by retention also faults with Conflict. Requires `type`, `signalName`, and exactly one of `signalId` or `idempotencyKey` (not both). Accepts `input`, `signalPayload`, and the non-idempotency start options from weft.workflows.start (`id`, `executionTimeout`, `startAt`/`startAfter`, `tags`, `searchAttributes`) plus `onTerminalConflict`; `idempotencyKey` is governed by the "exactly one of" rule above and cannot be combined with restart. Returns the workflow `id`. Concurrent callers converge on one workflow and one signal only with a shared `idempotencyKey`, or a shared `id` plus `signalId`; a bare `signalId` (no `id`/`idempotencyKey`) starts a fresh run per caller and does not converge.

signalName.description: Signal name. Must be a non-empty string.

type.description: Workflow type name. Runtime validation requires a non-empty string.

operations.name: weft.workflows.streams.chunks
operations.summary: Read stored stream chunks for a workflow stream key

operations.name: weft.workflows.streams.sse
operations.summary: Stream workflow tokens as Server-Sent Events

operations.name: weft.workflows.suspend
operations.summary: Suspend a running workflow
operations.description: Request suspension of a running workflow by `id` without terminating it. The workflow transitions to the non-terminal `suspended` status, keeps its durable checkpoint, and is later resumable via `resume`. Unlike cancellation, suspension does not run cancel handlers and does not settle the result. Suspending a workflow that is not running is a no-op. Faults with Unprocessable when the engine runs in worker execution mode (which cannot pause a run without cancelling it).

operations.name: weft.workflows.tags.add
operations.summary: Add workflow tags

operations.name: weft.workflows.tags.remove
operations.summary: Remove workflow tags

operations.name: weft.workflows.timeline.get
operations.summary: Get the structured execution timeline for a workflow

operations.name: weft.workflows.timeout
operations.summary: Force-timeout a workflow
operations.description: Force a running workflow into the timed-out terminal state by `id`, as if its execution timeout had elapsed. Irreversible. Use for operator intervention on stuck workflows. Faults with NotFound when the workflow is not visible.

operations.name: weft.workflows.update
operations.summary: Send a synchronous update to a workflow
operations.description: Invoke a named update handler on a workflow and wait for its result. Requires the workflow `id` and the update `name`; `payload` is optional. Unlike signals, updates return the handler result synchronously. Faults with NotFound when the workflow is not visible and InvalidParams when the payload exceeds the size limit.
